settings.openai-codex.ultrafastUnsupported: Ultrafast supports only Codex Astra and Sol61.
settings.openai-codex.ultrafastDisclosure: Ultrafast uses more quota. Account eligibility and the tier actually served are unverified. No automatic fallback.
settings.openai-codex.ultrafastUnavailable: Open a signed-in conversation to select Ultrafast. This does not establish account eligibility.
settings.openai-codex.speedMenuStandardTitle: Current: Standard speed. Click to choose a speed.
settings.openai-codex.speedMenuFastTitle: Current: Fast speed. Click to choose a speed.
settings.openai-codex.speedMenuUltrafastTitle: Current: Ultrafast speed. Click to choose a speed.
settings.openai-codex.title: Codex Connect
settings.openai-codex.modelsProviderSupport: Powered by the Codex Connect plugin.
settings.openai-codex.intro: Use your ChatGPT subscription in dsh, with optional GPT Image generation and no API key.
settings.openai-codex.runtimeUnavailable: Host identity is unknown. Check this page’s DSH connection/authentication, then recheck; this does not prove the plugin is broken.
settings.openai-codex.runtimeVersionsMatch: Browser, Host plugin and installed package declare the same plugin version.
settings.openai-codex.runtimeVersionsUnknown: Some plugin version evidence is unavailable; consistency is unknown.
settings.openai-codex.runtimeMismatchHelp: If only the page differs, refresh it. If Host and installed versions differ, save your work before a normal Host restart. This check performs neither action.
settings.openai-codex.runtimeEvidenceBoundary: DSH versions are selected-installation metadata. Matching version declarations do not prove identical package bytes, the Desktop shell version, or full feature acceptance.
settings.openai-codex.runtimePrivacy: This identity check does not request an account/model, read OAuth contents, install dependencies or upload the receipt. The receipt excludes account identifiers, conversation content and filesystem paths.
settings.openai-codex.activeAccountHelp: Account changes apply to new Codex requests. Running requests are not changed.
settings.openai-codex.addingAccountKeepsCurrent: Browser authorization is still pending. The current account remains selected for new requests.
settings.openai-codex.removeAccountCopy: Its local authorization credential will be deleted. Other accounts are not signed out.
settings.openai-codex.removeActiveAccountCopy: Its local authorization credential will be deleted and “{name}” will become the current account.
settings.openai-codex.removeLastAccountCopy: This is the last saved account. Removing it signs Codex Connect out.
settings.openai-codex.settingsSaveHint: Save applies changes to both settings entries. Closing discards unsaved changes.
settings.openai-codex.authorizationHelp: You can reopen the authorization page or cancel and start again. Cancelling does not sign out an existing account.
settings.openai-codex.manualCallbackToggle: Finish authorization with a callback URL
settings.openai-codex.manualCallbackHelp: Using a browser on another device? After ChatGPT authorization, a localhost connection error is expected because DSH runs elsewhere. Copy the full URL from that browser’s address bar and paste it here, including the entire query string. If you returned to this page, use Continue authorization (or Reopen authorization) to rejoin the pending sign-in.
settings.openai-codex.manualCallbackPrivacy: This URL contains temporary sign-in secrets. Submit it only here; do not share it in chat, logs, or screenshots. The input is cleared after submission and is not saved.
settings.openai-codex.callbackAccepted: Callback accepted. Waiting for authorization to finish…
settings.openai-codex.callbackInvalid: The callback URL or authorization state is invalid. Copy the full URL from the current authorization and try again.
settings.openai-codex.callbackNoPending: No authorization is pending. Continue authorization or start sign-in again.
settings.openai-codex.callbackFailed: The callback could not be submitted. Try again or continue authorization.
settings.openai-codex.callbackUnconfirmed: The submission timed out and may have been accepted. Continuing to check authorization status…
settings.openai-codex.modelsAccountHelp: Proxy, model visibility, search and image options remain in Settings → Plugins → Codex Connect, or open them here:
settings.openai-codex.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this dsh page and retry.
settings.openai-codex.popupBlockedFallback: The sign-in window could not be opened automatically. Use the link below to continue in your browser.
settings.openai-codex.requestFailed: The OpenAI Codex account request failed.
settings.openai-codex.remoteOriginTitle: Remote browser origin is not trusted
settings.openai-codex.remoteOriginDescription: Codex Connect accepts browser OAuth requests only from trusted local pages or origins explicitly approved by the device owner.
settings.openai-codex.remoteOriginCommandHelp: Run this command manually on the device that runs DSH, then reload this page. This page never runs it:
settings.openai-codex.remoteOriginCopyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Copy the command manually.
settings.openai-codex.desktopOriginDescription: Fully quit and restart DSH Desktop, then try authorization again.
settings.openai-codex.desktopOriginDiagnosticsHelp: If the problem continues, check the Desktop runtime and Codex Connect versions and collect diagnostics for the Desktop profile. Web origin trust commands do not apply to the Desktop app.
settings.openai-codex.modelCatalogIntro: Choose which Codex models appear in model selectors. Existing conversations can continue using a hidden model.
settings.openai-codex.modelCatalogFailed: Available models could not be loaded.
settings.openai-codex.contextLimitFallback: No higher configuration limit confirmed; capped at the installed catalog default.
settings.openai-codex.contextAboveDefault: Above the catalog default: larger requests may consume more quota or be rejected by your account or route. This plugin has not capacity-tested this range.
settings.openai-codex.contextWarning: Context overrides change client budgeting, not server capacity. An excessive value can cause requests to fail. Hiding a model keeps its budget. Changes apply after Save.
settings.openai-codex.contextInvalid: Enter a whole-number budget within the model’s configuration range, or choose Restore default.
settings.openai-codex.capabilitiesIntro: Choose which extra Codex capabilities this dsh profile may register.
settings.openai-codex.networkIntro: Codex Connect uses a direct connection by default. When needed, detect a local proxy or enter one manually.
settings.openai-codex.directConnectionDescription: Codex Connect does not use a dedicated proxy.
settings.openai-codex.currentConnectionFailed: The saved proxy could not reach the Codex endpoint.
settings.openai-codex.automaticDetectionHelp: Checks common local proxy ports and environment variables without changing the saved connection.
settings.openai-codex.manualProxyHelp: Enter an HTTP(S) proxy address without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
settings.openai-codex.pendingProxy: After saving, Codex Connect will use {proxyUrl}.
settings.openai-codex.pendingDirect: After saving, Codex Connect will stop using the proxy and connect directly.
settings.openai-codex.proxyCandidatesFound: Working proxy candidates found. Choose one to stage it for activation.
settings.openai-codex.proxyDetectionFailed: No working proxy candidate was found. Check DNS, connection refused, timeout, TLS, or proxy authentication errors, then try again.
settings.openai-codex.proxyTestRequired: Test this exact proxy address successfully before activation.
settings.openai-codex.invalidProxyUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) proxy origin without credentials or a path.
settings.openai-codex.enableSearchHelp: Makes OpenAI Codex available and selects it for profile-wide web search while enabled.
settings.openai-codex.enableImageToolHelp: Allows approved local reads and public-network image fetches for vision-capable models.
settings.openai-codex.enableImageGenerationHelp: Generate or edit images while keeping your current chat model, including DeepSeek. Image tools return selection handles for continued editing; only the selected target and reference images are sent to the image service.
settings.openai-codex.newSessionSpeedHelp: Independent opt-in defaults, applied once at startup. Legacy preferences are preserved when omitted or reset. Ultrafast applies only to signed-in Codex Astra/Sol61 sessions; sign-in is required before startup. Existing/manual choices stay unchanged; entitlement is not verified.
settings.openai-codex.reasoningEffortHelp: Optional fallback for requests without an explicit effort. The selected model must support it; unsupported choices fail before dispatch. This does not change service tier.
settings.openai-codex.enableNewSessionFastModeHelp: Off by default. New top-level conversations using Codex request priority service; existing conversations and their manual choices stay unchanged. Priority may use quota faster.
settings.openai-codex.enableNewSubagentFastMode: Fast Mode for new subagent conversations
settings.openai-codex.enableNewSubagentFastModeHelp: A separate opt-in default for new subagent conversations using Codex. Off by default; it does not inherit the top-level setting.
settings.openai-codex.retiredReserveNotice: Luna Reserve has been removed; legacy settings are ignored. Select an ordinary model explicitly to continue an old Reserve conversation.
settings.openai-codex.enableNativeCompactionHelp: Automatically use Codex native compaction when a long conversation needs context management. It aims to retain key requirements and task progress so long tasks can continue with less repeated background.
settings.openai-codex.nativeCompactionConsent: Enable and save to authorize automatic handling for Codex conversations in this profile, without triggering or confirming each compaction. This does not switch models, change reasoning effort, or enable other capabilities.
settings.openai-codex.nativeCompactionRisk: Compaction can lose details; it is not a complete copy of the conversation.
settings.openai-codex.nativeCompactionHostPolicy: Uses DSH’s existing context-management timing and thresholds. If the host has explicitly disabled automatic compaction or has no compaction service, this switch does not override that host configuration.
settings.openai-codex.nativeCompactionDisableHelp: If native compaction is unavailable, DSH can use its normal summary path. Disabling stops new native compactions; in-flight requests may finish and existing native session checkpoints remain readable.
settings.openai-codex.imageModelHintHelp: Optional unverified route hint; it may be ignored or rejected and does not guarantee the returned model.
settings.openai-codex.invalidImageModelHint: Use an empty value or 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
settings.openai-codex.enableAutoReviewHelp: Send eligible approval requests from OpenAI-Codex sessions to a separate Codex reviewer. This changes who reviews; it does not expand DSH file, network, or tool permissions.
settings.openai-codex.autoReviewDetails: What is sent and how failures are handled
settings.openai-codex.autoReviewDisclosure: Review requests send recent conversation text, relevant tool calls and results, tool arguments, the working directory, and the planned action to chatgpt.com. Hidden reasoning and stored credentials are not sent.
settings.openai-codex.autoReviewFailureDisclosure: If the reviewer cannot complete, DSH keeps human approval. An explicit denial blocks the action.
settings.openai-codex.generatingDetail: Image generation is in progress. Stopping cancels the current turn.
settings.openai-codex.choosePreviewEdit: Use this conversation preview (the original is unavailable)
settings.openai-codex.previewEditNotice: Only the saved preview is available. Editing it may reduce image quality.
settings.openai-codex.imageRequestUncertain: The service may still be processing this request. Repeating it can consume additional quota.
settings.openai-codex.imageUnknownFailure: The image request failed. Private service details are hidden; check the selected images and account before trying again.
settings.openai-codex.imageInputRecovery: Correct the selection or instructions in the conversation before retrying. Specify whether to edit the uploaded copy or the stored original; repeating these inputs will not resolve this error.
settings.openai-codex.imageStorageRecovery: Check local storage and available space before trying again. The service may already have processed this request.
settings.openai-codex.regenerateRequest: Generate another image with the previous image prompt unchanged.
settings.openai-codex.editRequest: Continue from the previous image. Ask me what I want to change before generating a new image.
settings.openai-codex.actionFailed: The follow-up request could not be sent.
settings.openai-codex.canceledDetail: Local waiting stopped. The request may still be processing.
settings.openai-codex.unknownResult: The image result could not be displayed safely.
settings.openai-codex.imagePreviewUnavailable: The original is saved, but its conversation preview is unavailable. Download the original or modify this image; no new generation is needed to recover it.
settings.openai-codex.loadFailed: Image could not be loaded. Retry
settings.openai-codex.routingNote: These settings never change the default model. Codex Search temporarily owns the profile-wide search route while enabled.
settings.openai-codex.settingsUnavailable: Plugin settings are unavailable in this dsh profile.
settings.openai-codex.settingsReadOnly: This profile exposes plugin settings as read-only.
settings.openai-codex.invalidSearchTokens: Maximum search output tokens must be a positive whole number.
settings.openai-codex.settingsSaveFailed: The settings could not be saved. Your unsaved changes are still available; retry or discard them.
settings.openai-codex.compatibilityPluginUpdateBody: Your installed plugin is not verified with this DSH version, but the latest plugin is. Update the plugin before DSH.
settings.openai-codex.compatibilityPluginCurrentOnly: Codex Connect: Current {current} · Latest version unavailable
settings.openai-codex.upToDate: You are using the latest available version ({version}).
settings.openai-codex.updateCheckUnavailable: Update information is unavailable right now. Check again later.
settings.openai-codex.versionsBehind: {count} published release(s) behind your current version.
settings.openai-codex.versionsBehindUnknown: The number of releases between these versions is unavailable.
settings.openai-codex.noCuratedHighlights: No user-facing highlights were provided. See the full release notes for technical details.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightTrustedOrigins: Remote browser access can now be explicitly trusted for a LAN setup.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightRuntimeCompatibility: Added a compatibility check and diagnostics so you can see whether the DSH and Node versions are supported.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightQuotaFastMode: Added per-conversation Fast Mode and GPT quota/reset indicators in the Composer.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightDshRc7: Added compatibility with DSH rc.7 plugin slots and a clearer runtime compatibility check.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightSearchStability: Improved search-session stability so new search records remain readable after restarts.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightImageGeneration: Added optional GPT Image generation in the Codex Connect settings and a preview card in the conversation.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightOauthHistory: Added safer session-history migration and a sign-in fallback when the account needs to reconnect.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightModelVisibility: You can now choose which Codex models appear in model selectors.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightProxyConnection: Added opt-in Codex proxy detection with explicit confirmation and a visible direct-connection fallback.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightModelsAccount: Added an Openai-Codex account card in Models settings for authorization, quota, and shared plugin settings.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightContextBudget: Added bounded per-model context budget controls while preserving each catalog default until you save an override.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightAutoReviewProbe: Added an explicit, synthetic probe for checking whether the hidden Codex approval reviewer is available without enabling it.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightAutoReview: Added optional Codex Auto-review for eligible Harness approvals, with first-use disclosure, fail-closed human fallback, and an exact-retry override.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightAstraCompatibility: Added GPT-6-Astra compatibility metadata when the installed upstream catalog does not provide the model.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightMultiAccount: Added management for multiple ChatGPT accounts; starting or cancelling authorization preserves existing accounts.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightSearchRoute: Enabling Codex Search now selects the profile-wide search route; disabling it restores the previous provider.
settings.openai-codex.updateHighlightImageModelHint: Added an optional profile-scoped image route model hint. It is unverified, may be ignored or rejected, and does not guarantee the returned model.
settings.openai-codex.releaseNotesUnavailable: Release notes are available on the release page.
settings.openai-codex.agentPromptCopyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Copy the Agent prompt manually.
settings.openai-codex.agentUpgradePrompt: Please inspect this project’s published installation instructions and identify whether the current DSH is Desktop or Web before preparing a compatible plugin upgrade for the correct profile. Preserve credentials and user defaults; do not force version checks or start another Host: {repository}
settings.openai-codex.agentUpgradeHelp: Copy this short request to your Agent. It can inspect the project instructions and choose the appropriate install or update method.
settings.openai-codex.agentUpgradeFinish: After the Agent reports completion, return here and check the installed version again.
settings.openai-codex.upgradeStillAvailable: The Host still reports plugin version {version}. Check Runtime identity before deciding whether to refresh or restart.
settings.openai-codex.upgradeCheckSuccess: The Host reports the latest published plugin version. Check Runtime identity in plugin settings for installed-package and page versions.
